newsitem.title: POLAND: Jelfa sets minimum issue price at PLN 34.
newsitem.headline: Jelfa sets minimum issue price at PLN 34.

text.p: Polish pharmaceuticals firm Jelfa SA set the minimum issue price of its 1.5-million-share issue at 34 zlotys per share, the company said in an abbreviatred version of its issue prospectus.
The final issue price would be announced on February 15 at the latest.

It said the subscription period for the large investors' tranche, amounting to one million shares, would be from February 17 to February 20. Large-scale investors will be allowed to bid for between 50,000 and 500,000 shares.
The small investors' tranche will amount to 500,000 shares and subscription will take place between February 24 and March 7.
Jelfa now has 5.3 million shares outstanding.
The company also said it expected to net 24.4 million zlotys on 187.0-million-zloty sales this year, up from 20.2 million zlotys and 156.1-million-zlotys respectively in 1996.
